audit.why: Kit is authoritative on slots and cooldowns; Xerath R is an interruptible channel.

edits.before: - Taliyah Seismic Shove: matchup-defining — The shove into Unraveled Earth is her whole setup — sidestep it and the burst whiffs. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Shocking Orb has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.

edits.before: Weaver's Wall (R) is a roaming and repositioning tool, not a lane-kill button, so your 6 poke lead holds; her all-in needs a landed Seismic Shove (E) knock-up, which you sidestep by keeping distance and holding your W slow on her.
edits.after: Weaver's Wall (R) is a roaming and repositioning tool, not a lane-kill button, so your 6 poke lead holds; her all-in needs a landed Seismic Shove (W) knock-up, which you sidestep by keeping distance and holding your W slow on her.

edits.before: You out-range Taliyah's poke early: her Threaded Volley (Q) pushes the wave but a single shot doesn't out-trade your charged Arcanopulse (Q), and she has to be in your range to shove. Poke her with Eye of Destruction (W) into Q every time she steps up, and don't get shoved under tower where her Seismic Shove (E) can set up a gank. Match her wave so she has no free roam timer. Play the range gap and you control the lane.

edits.before: Through 3-6 you keep the poke advantage; her worked-ground mechanic makes her Q push fall off mid-wave, so shove back and chunk her when she comes up to farm. Her only real kill setup is landing Seismic Shove (E) into her combo, which you deny by holding distance and pre-slowing with W. Weaver's Wall (R) is a map tool, so 6 doesn't shift the lane, but ward for her to pair it with jungle roams. Keep the wave even and starve her tempo.
